💎 Match3

A grid of colored gems — swap adjacent tiles to create a line of three or more matching gems. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Swap adjacent gems by clicking one and then an adjacent one.
  2. Only swaps that create a match of 3+ are allowed.
  3. Match 3 in a row or column to clear them and score points.
  4. Special gems (4-match, 5-match) create powerful cascade effects.
  5. Plan swaps that trigger chain reactions for maximum scores.
